hoy.titular: From the party to Montevideo: 121 coaches sold out
hoy.resumen: With the 20th star freshly won, the squad is resting and returns to City Bell on Monday to prepare for the Libertadores final against Palmeiras, on Saturday 28th at the Centenario. Fans snapped up all 121 coaches organised by the club.
puntos: Coaches to Montevideo: sold out. The club confirmed a record convoy of 121 coaches heading to the Centenario.
Seats for the final: sold out. The club will tell members if any more become available.
Saturday 14, 7pm to midnight: the Estudiantes Museum shows off its revamp at Museos a la Luz de la Luna, at the club headquarters (53 No. 620).

linea.texto: Medina made history: he is the first foreign manager to win a title with Estudiantes.
The squad remains on leave and returns to training on Monday in City Bell, with Palmeiras in sight.
A Saturday of youth football against Tigre: the U-15 to U-13 sides play at City Bell from 9am (streamed on the club's YouTube channel), while the older youth sides play away.
Guido Carrillo, the man for finals: he has scored in four of the nine finals he has played for the Pincha.
A historic convoy: fans sold out all 121 coaches to travel to the Centenario.
Mayor Alak congratulated the champions and La Plata's town hall was lit up in red and white.

noticias.titulo: 121 coaches sold out: a record convoy to Montevideo
noticias.bajada: The club confirmed every coach for the final against Palmeiras has been sold. There are still no extra seats available.

noticias.titulo: Champions after extra time, with an Alario header
noticias.bajada: Carrillo and an own goal made it 2-0, Rivadavia levelled in stoppage time and Alario won it in extra time. Medina was sent off.

noticias.titulo: The Museum gets a makeover and opens on Saturday night
noticias.bajada: Museos a la Luz de la Luna: Saturday 14, 7pm to midnight, at the club headquarters, with QR codes and interactive experiences.

noticias.titulo: Seats sold out, and another wave of complaints
